source_name: EEA s.r.o. - Referencie, segment 'Banky a finančný sektor'
why_relevant: Segment-filtered reference directory for SK banking clients (e.g. Tatra banka toolchain integration and a CMDB consolidation across ~30 systems). The segment filter makes it a clean, machine-friendly pointer surface listing named SK financial-sector customers.

source_name: Euronet Slovakia - independent ATM deployer (euronet.sk / euronetatms.com)
source_subtype: independent ATM deployer corporate site + blog
why_relevant: Largest independent (non-bank) ATM deployer in SK. Its merchant-facing 'ATM solutions' pages and news centre are the supplier-side window on the IAD share of the SK ATM estate and on cash-access trends as banks shrink their own fleets. The CZ sibling site has a dedicated banks/ATM-supplier page (euronetatms.cz/banky) indicating outsourcing offers to banks.

source_name: Protimonopolný úrad SR (PMÚ / Antimonopoly Office) - koncentrácie decisions
why_relevant: Merger-control decisions describe vendor market structure in Slovakia in ways vendors never publish - e.g. the decision clearing Diebold's acquisition of Wincor Nixdorf discusses the SK ATM-supply market. Decisions on payment/IT/vendor deals often enumerate competitors, distribution channels and market shares.

source_name: NBS register of supervised entities (subjekty.nbs.sk) - vendor/PSP entity records
why_relevant: Authoritative SK register that also carries entries for technology-adjacent regulated entities; a Printec Slovakia entity record surfaced here. Use it to resolve vendor legal identities, licences (payment institution / e-money), and to discover unlisted processors and payment-service providers operating in SK.

source_name: FinStat.sk + ORSR.sk - vendor financials and corporate history
why_relevant: Vendor revenue/profit trajectories are a proxy for SK bank technology spend when the banks themselves disclose nothing. FinStat also preserves corporate history that decodes the vendor landscape - e.g. PRINTEC SLOVAKIA's historical name 'NCR Slovensko, spol. s r.o.' (renamed 2001), which explains the NCR-Printec channel relationship. ORSR gives the authoritative company extract.

source_name: ČSOB SK - platobné terminály (bank-side terminal vendor disclosure)
why_relevant: Bank merchant pages disclose the terminal makes/models a bank fields (third-party SK resellers list Verifone V200c/P400 as the ČSOB and Tatra banka models), letting the vendor-share of the SK acceptance estate be reconstructed bank by bank.

source_name: SK terminal resellers / POS integrators (EXALOGIC, BOWA, ELCOMP, PORTOS)
why_relevant: The eKASA-driven cash-register channel resells payment terminals and states plainly which OEM/acquirer pairings exist in SK (PAX via Global Payments, Verifone FiskalPRO, Ingenico via AXASOFT, Verifone from ČSOB/Tatra banka). Price lists and model catalogues are a bottom-up read on the installed terminal base that no bank publishes.

source_name: Tapeon s.r.o. - SK ISO-certified Visa/Mastercard payment solutions provider
source_subtype: market-overview blog acting as vendor pointer
why_relevant: Tapeon (founded 2015) is described as an official ISO-certified Visa/Mastercard partner in SK supplying terminals to independent merchants, retail chains, self-service kiosks and e-shops - i.e. a non-bank acceptance channel that sits outside bank acquiring disclosure. The llarik.sk overview also maps SK terminal fee structures and providers, making it a useful pointer to the long tail of SK payment vendors.

source_name: Novopayment.sk - SK POS / SoftPOS provider
why_relevant: Independent SK payment-terminal and SoftPOS provider targeting merchants, kiosks and service providers; product pages indicate which card schemes and wallets are supported and where SoftPOS is displacing hardware terminals in SK.

source_name: OpenWay Group - Way4 customer/news blog (processor platform vendor)
why_relevant: Card-management/switching platform vendor that publishes named CEE processor wins (e.g. Mastercard Payment Transaction Services tokenization on Way4; BORICA migration in Bulgaria). Relevant as the class of vendor that would announce any SK issuer/acquirer platform migration; no SK-named customer was found in this pass.

source_name: ATM Marketplace / ATMIA vendor showrooms and showcases
why_relevant: Industry-trade aggregators that host vendor showrooms, product showcases and deployment news across the ATM/self-service industry. Good snowballing surface for identifying which OEMs, software vendors and managed-service firms are active in CEE, and for catching SK deployment announcements that never reach SK media.

source_name: KPMG SK newsroom - payments M&A notes (e.g. Solitea acquiring Pay Solutions)
why_relevant: Advisor deal announcements name SK payment-technology targets and acquirers that rarely publicise themselves (IT holding Solitea buying Pay Solutions). Advisory newsrooms are a systematic route to SK payment-vendor consolidation events and to discovering smaller processors/gateways.

source_name: European Commission merger case file M.10378 (VUB / Slovenská sporiteľňa / Tatra banka JV)
why_relevant: EC merger file covering a joint venture of the three largest SK banks - such filings typically describe shared ATM/self-service infrastructure, supplier arrangements and market shares in the SK cash-access market, quantified in a way neither the banks nor their vendors publish.

source_name: GlobalData — Slovakia Cards and Payments: Opportunities and Risks to 2028
why_relevant: Commercial market-sizing report re-cutting SK card, debit/credit, e-commerce and POS data into market size + forecast series; store page and sample TOC expose headline metrics and segmentation even without purchase.

source_name: Argus Advisory Research — Slovakia Cards & Payments Market Report
why_relevant: Country-level cards/payments research house with recurring SK edition; typically includes issuer-level card volumes and ATM/POS terminal counts that primary sources publish only in aggregate.

source_name: Verisk Financial Research — Slovakia Country Report (cards & payments)
why_relevant: Second commercial cards/payments research house covering SK; useful as a cross-check on GlobalData/Argus numbers and for issuer/acquirer market-share estimates.

source_name: Statista Market Insights — Banking / Traditional Banks Slovakia outlook
why_relevant: Modelled market-size and CAGR forecasts for SK banking sub-segments; convenient aggregated re-cut with visible headline numbers, but modelled rather than observed — treat as directional.

source_name: Moody's Ratings — Slovakia bank and sovereign research hub
why_relevant: Rating agency must disclose sector metrics (deposit growth, loan books, funding mix, profitability) to justify opinions on SK banks; press releases for rating actions are free and carry hard numbers.

source_name: Moody's multi-country rating action PDF covering Slovak banking groups (depositor-preference actions)
why_relevant: Concrete example of a free full-text rating action naming SK banking groups; shows the artefact type worth harvesting systematically.

source_name: Ministry of Finance SR — Rating Agencies page (agency reports on SK)
why_relevant: Official pointer page collecting/linking S&P, Moody's, Fitch assessments of Slovakia — a low-friction index into agency material that is otherwise behind registration.

source_name: IMF — Slovak Republic Financial System Stability Assessment (FSAP)
why_relevant: Independent analytical intermediary that re-cuts NBS/ECB primary data into structural sector metrics (concentration, foreign ownership, payment-system oversight); free full PDF.

source_name: Deloitte Slovensko — Digital Banking Maturity (SK country cut)
why_relevant: Recurring benchmark of SK retail banks' digital channels (1,000+ functionalities); the only openly published consultancy dataset that ranks individual Slovak banks on payments/onboarding functionality.

source_name: Deloitte Central Europe Banking Outlook
why_relevant: CE-wide banking sector analysis with SK country tables (assets, profitability, digital adoption) — aggregates supervisory data into comparable cross-country series.

source_name: Ipsos SK — Slovenská banková asociácia study on perception of banks
why_relevant: Named market-research vendor (Ipsos) publishing methodology and topline results of a representative SK banking-perception survey commissioned by the banking association; recurring series usable for attitudes toward banks, fees and digital payment.

source_name: SBA (Slovenská banková asociácia) — Štatistiky a analýzy
why_relevant: Association section that aggregates sector statistics and commissioned analyses; acts as the main pointer into SK banking-industry survey research and into which agencies (Ipsos, 2muse, Focus) are used.

source_name: Mastercard Slovensko payment-behaviour survey releases (via SK trade/press channels)
why_relevant: Scheme-commissioned consumer research is the most frequent public source of SK mobile/card/cash preference splits (e.g. mobile payments 56% vs 21% in 2019); distributed through SK press-release wires rather than a stable corporate page.

source_name: Finsider.sk — analytical finance outlet (payments/cash coverage)
why_relevant: Specialist SK financial outlet that reworks NBS/scheme/bank data into quantified stories (card volumes, per-card transaction counts); efficient discovery layer for otherwise unpublicised bank-internal statistics.

source_name: FinReport.sk — payments trend analyses
why_relevant: Aggregates ECB/scheme payment statistics into SK-framed trend pieces; useful for tracking which analytical outputs circulate in the SK market and for citation trails to primary datasets.

source_name: oPeniazoch.sk (Zoznam) — survey/press aggregation on payment behaviour
why_relevant: High-volume SK finance portal that republishes bank, scheme and agency survey releases; the fastest single feed for discovering new SK payment-behaviour studies as they appear.
